in_marathi.name: Basudev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all beings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basudev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Basudev' is derived from Sanskrit words 'BASU' meaning 'Lord' and 'DEV' meaning 'God'. This name represents the divine being who is the ruler and protector of all beings.
